image_description: A Roseate Spoonbill standing in shallow, dark water. The bird features distinctive pink plumage on its body and wings, with a white neck and head. It has long, reddish-pink legs partially submerged, creating a reflection in the rippled water. The most prominent feature is its long, flat, spatulate bill, which is pale greyish-yellow. The background consists of blurred green vegetation along the water's edge.
